test.title: A habit you would like to change

document.cue: Describe a habit you would like to change.

text: The habit I'd most like to change is my tendency to leave important tasks until the very last minute. Procrastination, basically.

I think it started in high school. I was quite a good student, so I could usually get away with writing an essay the night before it was due, and I got used to working under pressure. The problem is that university assignments are much longer, and that strategy doesn't really work any more.

Last semester, for example, I had three weeks to write a research paper, and I spent the first two tidying my room, reorganising my notes and watching videos about productivity — which is quite ironic. I ended up writing most of it in two sleepless nights, and although I passed, I knew it wasn't my best work.

The main reason I want to change is that it affects more than my grades. When a deadline is hanging over me, I can't really relax, even when I'm with friends, so I end up feeling guilty all the time. I'd also like to get into good habits now, before I start a full-time job where missing deadlines has real consequences.
Recently I've started breaking tasks into small pieces and doing the first one immediately, and so far it seems to be helping.

tips.en: Watching productivity videos instead of working — which is quite ironic.
tips.kk: Жұмыстың орнына өнімділік туралы видео — which is quite ironic.
tips.ru: Видео о продуктивности вместо работы — which is quite ironic.

tips.en: Two reasons at different times give the answer depth.
tips.kk: Әртүрлі уақыттағы екі себеп — жауап тереңірек.
tips.ru: Две причины на разных отрезках времени — ответ глубже.
tips.example: before I start a full-time job where missing deadlines has real consequences

note.en: What the habit is — straight away, with a short term at the end.
note.kk: Қандай әдет — бірден, соңында қысқа терминмен.
note.ru: Что за привычка — сразу, с коротким термином в конце.

note.en: When it started and why it used to work.
note.kk: Қашан басталды және бұрын неге жарады.
note.ru: Когда началось и почему раньше это работало.

note.en: The research-paper example shows the damage, with some self-irony.
note.kk: Курстық жұмыс мысалы әдеттің зиянын көрсетеді — өзін-өзі әжуалаумен.
note.ru: Пример с курсовой показывает вред привычки — с самоиронией.

note.en: Why I want to change — two reasons: now and in the future.
note.kk: Неге өзгерткім келеді — екі себеп: қазір және болашақта.
note.ru: Почему хочу изменить — две причины: сейчас и в будущем.

note.en: The ending shows what I am already doing, without big promises.
note.kk: Аяқталуы — қазір не істеп жатқаным, үлкен уәдесіз.
note.ru: Концовка — что уже делаю, без громких обещаний.
